newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3918/3.3941 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3918/3.3941 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3905 to 3.3930 bid and 3.3920 to 3.3980 offer in the interbank market on Thursday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3918 pounds bid and 3.3941 offered. The averages compared to of 3.3927 pounds bid and 3.3949 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.392571 buy and 3.396450 sell.
